result.brief: 提出基于时变部分定向相干与预训练 CNN/ViT 特征的脑电压力分析框架，与视频/多模态世界模型及视觉表征学习无关。
result.reason: EEG mental-stress classification using TV-PDC connectivity maps and pretrained CNN/ViT backbones as frozen feature extractors; no contribution to video/multimodal world models, generative latents, or visual representation learning.
